in_marathi.name: Havya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Havya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Havya is derived from the Sanskrit language and it means 'wealth', 'prosperity'. In Hindu mythology, Havya is a goddess who is associated with abundance and wealth. She is often depicted holding a pot of gold or grain, symbolizing her role as the giver of material blessings.
